name: bangerz-army
description: Search the Bangerz Army DJ record pool by BPM, key and genre, check a request list (even a photo) against the catalogue, and save the tracks as a crate in your account.

interface.longDescription:
Bangerz Army is a record pool for DJs. This connector lets you dig through it in plain words.

What you can ask:
- Check a whole request list, even a photo of a handwritten sheet. Each line comes back as found, to confirm or missing.
- Search by artist, title, genre, BPM, key, version or year, or describe what you want, like "sunset deep house, not too vocal".
- Get every detail of one track (versions, BPM, key, label) and the tracks close to it.
- See what landed in the last days, by genre.
- Save tracks as a new crate, add them to one of your crates, or get a crate's public link.
- See what you already downloaded and what is still waiting in your crates.

Who can use it: Founders and invited members of Bangerz Army. You sign in with your Bangerz Army account when you connect. Any other account can still sign in, and the tools then explain how to become a Founder, with a link to https://bangerz-army.com/founders/.

What it does not do: it does not download files, buy anything or delete anything. Downloads stay on bangerz-army.com.

Setup and help: https://bangerz-army.com/mcp/
Privacy (section 2.8): https://bangerz-army.com/privacy-policy/
Support: hello@bangerz-army.com
defaultPrompt: Match this wedding request list: Dancing Queen ABBA, September Earth Wind & Fire, Mr. Brightside The Killers
Find 20 Afro House tracks between 120 and 124 BPM in 8A
Save the tracks you found as a crate called Saturday wedding and give me its link

positive.description: Search the catalogue by genre, BPM range and key
positive.prompt: Find 20 Afro House tracks between 120 and 124 BPM in 8A
positive.expected_behavior: Lists 20 Afro House tracks between 120 and 124 BPM in key 8A, ranked by popularity, each with artist, title, BPM, key, rating and a link to music.bangerz-army.com.

positive.description: Check a wedding request list against the catalogue
positive.prompt: Match this wedding request list: Dancing Queen - ABBA, September - Earth, Wind & Fire, Mr. Brightside - The Killers, Crazy in Love - Beyonce, Uptown Funk - Mark Ronson ft. Bruno Mars, I Wanna Dance with Somebody - Whitney Houston, Don't Stop Me Now - Queen, Shut Up and Dance - Walk the Moon, Perfect - Ed Sheeran, Levitating - Dua Lipa
positive.expected_behavior: Returns each line as found, to confirm (with the reason, for example only remixes held) or missing, with the versions held and a link. On the test account: 9 found, 1 to confirm, 0 missing.

positive.description: Save the found tracks as a crate
positive.prompt: Save the tracks you found as a crate called Reviewer test and give me its link
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the crate Reviewer test in the test account with the found tracks and gives its link on music.bangerz-army.com and a Download all link.

positive.prompt: What came out this week in Tech House?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the Tech House tracks added in the last 7 days, most popular first, with links.

positive.description: Tracks that mix well after a given track
positive.prompt: Find tracks that go with the first track of the Afro House list
positive.expected_behavior: Lists up to 20 tracks (10 by default) that mix well after that track, each with the reason (same subgenre, close BPM, key) and a link.

negative.description: Downloading audio files is not supported: downloads happen on bangerz-army.com
negative.prompt: Download these tracks to my computer

negative.description: Deleting crates or tracks is not supported: no tool deletes anything
Other members' personal data is never exposed
negative.prompt: Give me the email addresses of other members

review.commerce_description: Bangerz Army in ChatGPT does not sell anything or take payments. Membership is managed on bangerz-army.com.

publication.release_notes: First release: search the catalogue, check a request list, read new releases and similar tracks, and save tracks as crates.
